title.zh: 与严歌苓面对面：《米拉蒂》新书分享会

location.en: 2040 Valley Life Sciences Building · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 Valley Life Sciences Building · 2040 教室

summary.en: Writer Geling Yan joined Datong for a conversation about Milati, followed by audience questions and a book signing.
summary.zh: 严歌苓来到伯克利，与同学及湾区中文读者分享新作《米拉蒂》，并在问答与签售中继续交流。

en: Set against the cultural and intellectual changes of the 1980s, Milati follows a young woman’s passage from performing in a military arts troupe to writing and thinking independently. The conversation introduced the novel and Yan’s experience of writing and publishing it overseas.
The afternoon brought together an author presentation, audience Q&A, and a book signing. The event was conducted in Mandarin and organized by Datong Society.
zh: 《米拉蒂》以八十年代的文化与思想变动为背景，书写一位年轻女性从文工团舞者走向独立写作的经历。分享围绕小说中的人物与时代展开，也介绍了严歌苓在海外创作、出版这部作品的过程。
活动分为作家分享、观众问答与新书签售三个环节，以普通话进行，由大同学社组织，为校园与湾区读者提供了与作者面对面交流的机会。

title.en: The Piano in a Factory: Screening & Discussion
title.zh: 《钢的琴》：电影展映与学者讨论

location.en: 2030 Valley Life Sciences Building · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 Valley Life Sciences Building · 2030 教室

people.en: Guests: Kevin O’Brien and Lillian Xiying Lin
people.zh: 嘉宾：Kevin O’Brien（欧博文）、林溪瀛（Lillian）

summary.en: A screening of Zhang Meng’s film opened a conversation about industrial change, memory, and the lives of workers in Northeast China.
summary.zh: 从张猛导演的《钢的琴》出发，讨论东北的工业转型、下岗工人的生活，以及个体如何面对时代变动。

en: Set in a Northeast Chinese industrial city during the layoffs of the 1990s, the film follows a former steelworker who tries to build a piano for his daughter. Its story of family and friendship also offers a view of the changing place of industrial labor in everyday life.

The post-screening conversation featured Berkeley political scientist Kevin O’Brien and history PhD student Lillian Xiying Lin. Both guests brought connections to Northeast China to the discussion. The film was shown in Chinese with English subtitles, followed by discussion in English.
zh: 影片以上世纪九十年代下岗潮中的东北为背景，讲述原钢厂工人陈桂林为女儿制作钢琴的故事。亲情、友谊与旧工厂交织在一起，呈现工人生活在经济与社会转型中的变化。
映后讨论邀请伯克利政治学者欧博文与历史系博士生林溪瀛参加。两位嘉宾都与东北有着个人或任教经历上的联系，围绕影片及其所处的社会背景与观众交流。影片为中文、英文字幕，映后讨论使用英语。

title.en: The WeChat Lawsuit: A Conversation with Keliang Zhu
title.zh: 在美华人诉美国总统：朱可亮谈微信诉讼

location.en: Social Sciences Building, Room 60 · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 Social Sciences Building · 60 教室

summary.en: Attorney Keliang Zhu discussed the origins, course, and legal strategy of the challenge to the 2020 WeChat ban, and its implications for Chinese American civic participation.
summary.zh: 朱可亮律师分享美国微信用户挑战2020年微信禁令的来龙去脉、诉讼策略，以及这一案件对华人社群维权的启示。

en: Drawing on his involvement in the litigation, Zhu introduced how the case was organized and pursued. The lecture connected the history of the dispute with broader questions about legal advocacy and the ways a community can use the courts to defend its interests.
Held in Mandarin as part of Datong’s Chinese-language lecture series, the event brought students and members of the wider community together for a lecture and questions.
zh: 朱可亮结合参与诉讼的经历，介绍案件如何发起、推进，以及律师团队采取的法律策略。讲座从一个具体案件延伸至法律行动与公共参与，讨论华人社群如何通过司法途径维护自身权益。
本场活动是大同中文讲座系列的一部分，以普通话进行，包含嘉宾分享与观众问答。学生与社区观众在现场交流，共同讨论法律行动与公共参与。

title.en: Still Life: Screening with Peter Hessler & Andrew F. Jones
title.zh: 《三峡好人》：与何伟、Andrew F. Jones 映后交流

location.zh: 伯克利 Moffitt Library · 102 教室

people.en: Peter Hessler (online) · Andrew F. Jones (in person)
people.zh: 何伟（线上）· Andrew F. Jones（现场）

summary.en: Jia Zhangke’s film brought a Bay Area audience together for a conversation with writer Peter Hessler and Berkeley scholar Andrew F. Jones.
summary.zh: 贾樟柯的《三峡好人》将校园与湾区观众聚在一起，放映后与作家何伟、伯克利学者 Andrew F. Jones 交流。

en: Set amid the transformations of the Three Gorges region, Still Life follows people looking for family members as familiar landscapes are dismantled and rebuilt. Datong’s screening created space to consider these changes through film and conversation.

Peter Hessler joined the post-screening discussion over Zoom, while Andrew F. Jones attended in person. In a thank-you email the following morning, organizer Marshall Li recorded an audience of more than 160 people from across the Bay Area and the team’s wish to send Hessler a signed thank-you card.
The society’s earlier archive also records a screening of this film in 2015.
zh: 《三峡好人》以三峡地区的变迁为背景，跟随寻找亲人的人物，呈现拆迁与重建中的日常生活。大同通过放映和映后对谈，为观众提供从影像与写作经验思考这些变化的空间。
何伟通过 Zoom 参加映后讨论，Andrew F. Jones 在现场交流。组织者李沛航在次日的感谢邮件中记录，活动吸引了来自湾区的160余位观众，团队还准备向何伟寄送全体签名的感谢卡。
学社早期档案还记录了2015年对这部影片的一次放映。

cover_caption.zh: 何伟通过 Zoom 参加映后讨论

title.zh: 《中国市长》：纪录片放映与圆桌讨论

location.en: Goldman School of Public Policy, Room 250 · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 Goldman School of Public Policy · 250 教室

people.en: Jean Quan · Thomas Gold · Junius Brown (moderator)
people.zh: Jean Quan（关丽珍）· Thomas Gold（高棣民）· 主持：Junius Brown

summary.en: A documentary screening and panel on urban redevelopment, local governance, and the relationship between citizens and the state.
summary.zh: 从纪录片《中国市长》出发，讨论城市重建、地方治理，以及公民与政府之间的关系。

en: Zhou Hao’s documentary follows urban redevelopment in Datong, Shanxi, and the tensions surrounding the transformation of the city. Datong Society paired the film with perspectives from public service and research on Chinese politics and society.

The event program lists former Oakland mayor Jean Quan and Berkeley sociologist Thomas Gold as panelists, with Junius Brown moderating and Luxi Peng hosting. The screening was followed by a panel and audience Q&A. The original program acknowledges support from Andrew F. Jones, Annie Campbell Washington, and Jianye He.
The society’s earlier archive also records a screening of this film in 2015.
zh: 周浩执导的纪录片记录山西大同的城市改造及其引发的矛盾。大同学社将影片与公共服务、中国政治及社会研究的视角联系起来，邀请嘉宾与观众展开讨论。
原活动流程列出前奥克兰市长关丽珍、伯克利社会学者高棣民参加圆桌，Junius Brown 主持讨论，Luxi负责开场与现场主持。放映后安排圆桌及观众问答。原主持稿还向 Andrew F. Jones、Annie Campbell Washington 与何老师致谢。
学社早期档案还记录了2015年对这部影片的一次放映。

summary.en: A seminar on F-1 visa revocations and practical questions facing immigrant communities, with an announced program of attorney presentations, community resources, and audience Q&A.

en: The program addressed visa-related developments in 2025, interactions with law enforcement, and travel concerns. It was advertised with immigration attorneys and nonprofit leaders; this archive preserves the historical program rather than current legal guidance.
zh: 议程涵盖 2025 年的签证动态、与执法人员互动及出行相关问题，预告嘉宾包括移民律师与非营利机构负责人。此条目记录当时的活动议程。

summary.en: An online conversation with journalists Jiang Xue and Li Sipan about journalism, changing professional identities, and personal choices amid social change.
summary.zh: 与媒体人江雪、李思磐线上对谈，讨论新闻工作、职业身份转变及社会变迁中的个人选择。

en: The announced conversation traced experiences moving from reporting and editing in market-oriented media toward independent journalism, feminism, and social research.
zh: 活动预告围绕从市场化媒体记者、编辑走向独立媒体人、女权主义者及社会研究者的经历，讨论个人选择与时代背景之间的关系。

en: The lecture was presented primarily in Mandarin and explored the history of rural healthcare.
